messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — streaming tail latency SLO breach in us-west-2 (p99 > 8s). Triggered by streaming-metrics (auto). Paging oncall: @kai :pager: 

kai: ack — I'm on it. Any customers reporting errors?

customer-success-bot: We've got 3 support tickets in the last 12m mentioning partial responses and stalled chats. Two are enterprise customers on Dedicated pools in us-west-2.

kai: ok scope check. Pulling p95/p99 dashboards now. Querying metrics: 
```
sum(rate(streaming.response_tail_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)
```

kai: quick readout: p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 8.4s, error rate (5m) up 2.1% (mostly 204/timeout). Spike started ~ 2475000800.

sasha: FYI we merged a proxy change 2475000600 that lowered chunk flush interval from 100ms -> 500ms for batching optimization. PR: https://git.internal/r/proxy/changes/3598 

mike: reproducing locally against staging proxy shows chunks buffering and large gaps between SSE events when client is slow. Example curl trace: 
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://streaming.redwood.test/stream/long --verbose
# got initial headers, then 7s gap before next chunk
```

eng-runtime-oncall: @sasha that's suspicious — increasing flush interval would increase tail for slow consumers. Also seen some 502s at the proxy when backend kept connections open > 60s. Proxy logs excerpt: 
```
[2475000855] WARN connection idle timeout exceeded, upstream closed, client_backpressure=true
[2475000872] ERROR write failed: broken pipe
```

kai: guess: combined effect of larger flush intervals + client backpressure + proxy keepalive closing upstream leading to stalled/chunked streams. Impact concentrated on Dedicated pools behind proxy variant v2-optimize.

sasha: I can revert the flush interval change and push a hotfix. Rollback candidate: revert PR 3598 and restore 100ms flush. Also propose temporarily enabling heartbeat frames every 10s to keep connections alive.

mike: before rollback, can we mitigate by increasing proxy upstream keepalive to 120s and reduce proxy write buffer to avoid big aggregations? If safe, do config flip in us-west-2 only.

kai: mitigation plan (short):
- flip proxy keepalive to 120s in us-west-2 (config flag: proxy.keepalive_secs=120) 
- enable heartbeat frames (stream.heartbeat_ms=10000) at edge for affected pools
- rollback flush interval PR to restore 100ms once mitigations stable
- monitor p95/p99 and error rates for 30m

eng-runtime-oncall: I can flip keepalive and heartbeat in the edge cluster now, will do canary on 10% traffic.

sasha: preparing rollback PR now, will mark as hotfix. If canary shows improvement we'll fully roll out.

kai: doing impact calc: affected customers ~ 6% of streaming sessions in us-west-2, estimated session stalls increased from 0.4% -> 5.2% during spike. Customer-visible degraded responses: ~ 1200 sessions in 20m window. Not urgent data loss but degraded UX.

customer-success-bot: Notified two enterprise CSMs and opened incident notice to customers on status.redwood.ai/incidents/2475001234 (draft).

eng-runtime-oncall: canary flip initiated at 2475001300 — 10% traffic route to keepalive=120 + heartbeat. Monitoring logs.

mike: can confirm reduced chunk gaps in canary traces — p99 dropped from 8.4s -> ~1.6s on canary, error rate back to baseline for canary.

kai: looks promising. Proceed with rollback once canary stable for 5m. Sasha, push hotfix and ramp to 50% -> 100% over 10m.

sasha: hotfix merged and deployed to us-west-2 canary at 2475001505. Rollout steps: 50% @2475001520, 100% @2475001535.

eng-runtime-oncall: 50% rollout at 2475001520 — p99 trending down on rollout: 1.6s -> 600ms. No increase in backend CPU/latency observed.

kai: 100% rollout complete at 2475001535. Monitoring p95 ~ 180ms, p99 ~ 420ms. Error rate down to baseline.

customer-success-bot: Sent customer update: "We're mitigating streaming stalls; rollback complete; monitoring." CSM replies indicate they will follow up with affected users.

mike: postmortem notes to collect: - root cause: unsafe batching change (flush interval increase) combined with client backpressure and proxy keepalive defaults. - contributing: insufficient canary size or canarying on limited traffic types. - detection: SLO-based alerting worked (p99 threshold). - mitigation: rollback + keepalive/heartbeat flip.

kai: assigning follow-ups: 
- sasha: create postmortem PR and remediation plan (include improved canary strategy) — assignee sasha
- eng-runtime-oncall: add alert for sudden increase in chunk flush interval or proxy buffer growth — assignee eng-runtime-oncall
- mike: run load tests with slow consumer scenarios and add to regression suite — assignee mike

sasha: created postmortem draft https://git.internal/postmortems/2475001234-draft, will add timeline and comms.

kai: handing off to next on-call @carol — summary: rollback complete, customer notice sent, monitoring stable. Please watch p99 for next 2h.

carol: ack, taking over. Will keep rotation updated and escalate to infra if metrics regress.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity SEV2 -> mitigated. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/2475001234. Paging stopped. :white_check_mark: 

kai: final note — need to update runbook: streaming batching / proxy compatibility section. Will add to postmortem.

carol: adding to handoff: include contact for affected enterprise customers and link to hotfix PR.

incident-bot: This thread closed by oncall handoff at 2475001980. Monitoring continues for 2h.
